CustomField.label: Input Name
CustomField.description: The name of the input that receives the record Id. If blank: recordId for a flow, contextId for a quick action, and the only input of an Apex action. A screen flow run on selected rows receives their Ids in a text collection variable named ids, as flows launched from a list view do.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Leave blank to use recordId for flows and contextId for quick actions. Enter a name only if your flow or Apex action uses a different input.
